nodes.description: SouthKoreaJunket constructor: sets token address, beneficiary address and releaseTime = now + year.

Public release(uint256 _amount): reads token balance, unlocks 50% on first call, unlocks full balance after releaseTime, decrements unlocked and transfers tokens to beneficiary. No access control modifier and no msg.sender check.
External view balanceOf(): returns the token balance held by the contract.
ERC20Basic public token: address of the held token contract, called externally in release().
address public beneficiary: hard-coded recipient of released tokens.
uint256 public releaseTime: timestamp when full balance becomes unlockable.
uint256 public unlocked: amount currently withdrawable; written in release().
bool public withdrawalsInitiated: one-time flag gating the 50% unlock.
uint256 public year = 365 days: lockup duration constant used in the constructor.
block.timestamp (now): used for the releaseTime computation, the time gate in release() and returned by currentTime().
External call token.safeTransfer(beneficiary, _amount) (SafeERC20 -> ERC20Basic.transfer): untrusted token contract is invoked and can re-enter release().
Arithmetic in release(): balance.div(2) and unlocked.sub(_amount) via SafeMath (div/sub with assert-based checks).
Parameter _amount of release(): amount of tokens the caller asks to withdraw.
Local variable balance in release(): result of token.balanceOf(address(this)).
Arithmetic in the constructor: releaseTime = now + year (unchecked uint256 addition).

edges.reason: Constructor writes the token state variable.
Constructor writes the beneficiary state variable.
Constructor executes the releaseTime arithmetic.
block.timestamp (now) feeds the releaseTime computation, making the lockup schedule timestamp dependent.
year state variable is read in the releaseTime arithmetic.
Result of now + year is stored into the releaseTime state variable.
release() reads the token state variable to query the held balance.
token.balanceOf(address(this)) result is assigned to the local balance variable.
The token contract address is used as the target of the external transfer call.
release() reads releaseTime for the time gate comparison.
The 'now >= releaseTime' gate makes the unlock decision depend on block.timestamp.
release() reads withdrawalsInitiated to decide the 50% unlock.
release() reads unlocked to bound the requested amount.
Caller-supplied parameter _amount flows into release() as the withdrawal amount.
release() executes the SafeMath div/sub arithmetic.
Local balance is halved by balance.div(2).
Arithmetic result (half balance or full balance) is written into unlocked.
unlocked is set to the full balance once the release time has passed.
release() writes the unlocked state variable (initial unlock and decrement).
release() sets withdrawalsInitiated to true on the first call.
release() control flow reaches the external safeTransfer call.
Parameter _amount is the value transferred out by the external call.
beneficiary state variable is the destination of the external transfer.
The external token transfer hands control to an untrusted contract that can re-enter release() before/while state settles.
currentTime() returns block.timestamp, exposing a timestamp-dependent value to callers.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _amount is used only inside release(); it should be folded into the release function node.
Local variable balance is a temporary holder inside release() and should be merged into the release function node.
